selectionRule: Fixed named convenience sample ADBE CRM MSFT ORCL WMT TGT; one scheduled earnings release in each calendar release quarter 2024Q3 through 2025Q3. Selection does not use price returns or guidance direction. Not a representative historical stock universe.
verification: All 30 URLs discovered in web search results from issuer or SEC primary sources on October 27, 2026. This manifest does not assert raw receipt archival, complete document parsing, verified public timestamp, guidance-pair validation, or profitability. Search results can expose market commentary incidentally; no return data were collected or used for selection.
globalLimitations: Publication dates are date-only; exact public availability time remains unverified.
Current-hosted historical pages are not independently immutable point-in-time archives.

Guidance comparison requires the latest prior disclosure for the identical fiscal target period, metric, currency basis and consolidation scope; supporting disclosures may fall outside these 30 releases.
Keep missing, unchanged, cut, initiated, withdrawn and noncomparable guidance in the denominator.
Returns deliberately absent. No event here is approved for trading or a backtest.
